recipes.name: Meatball Sour Soup (Ciorbă de Perișoare)
recipes.description: Tender pork and rice meatballs simmered in a tangy borș broth with root vegetables and lovage.
instructions: Dice the onion, carrots, bell pepper and celery root and sweat them in oil in a large pot for 5 minutes.
Add 2.5 litres of water and simmer for 15 minutes until the vegetables start to soften.
Mix the minced meat with the rice, one egg, salt and pepper and shape into walnut-sized meatballs.
Drop the meatballs into the simmering soup and cook for 20 minutes.
Add the grated tomatoes and the borș, bring back to a boil and simmer for 10 minutes.
Season with salt, stir in the chopped lovage and serve hot with sour cream.

recipes.name: Rădăuți Chicken Soup (Ciorbă Rădăuțeană)
recipes.description: Creamy Bukovina chicken soup thickened with sour cream and egg yolks, finished with garlic and vinegar.
instructions: Simmer the chicken breast with the carrots, parsnip, celery root and onion in 2.5 litres of salted water for 35 minutes.
Lift out the chicken, shred it and return it to the pot; discard the onion.
Whisk the sour cream with the egg yolks and flour, then temper with a few ladles of hot soup.
Pour the mixture back into the pot, stirring constantly, and heat gently without boiling.
Stir in the crushed garlic and vinegar, season with salt and pepper and sprinkle with parsley.

recipes.name: Tripe Soup (Ciorbă de Burtă)
recipes.description: Rich, velvety beef tripe soup with a sour cream and egg liaison, served with garlic sauce and hot peppers.
instructions: Rinse the tripe well, then boil it with the beef bones, carrots, celery root and onion in 3 litres of water for about 3 hours until tender.
Remove the tripe, slice it into thin strips and strain the broth back into the pot.
Return the tripe to the broth and season with salt.
Whisk the sour cream with the egg yolks and crushed garlic, temper with hot broth and stir into the soup off the heat.
Add the vinegar, adjust the seasoning and serve with extra garlic, hot peppers and sour cream on the side.

recipes.name: Bean Sour Soup with Smoked Pork Knuckle
recipes.description: Hearty white bean ciorbă with a smoked ham hock, soured with borș and scented with thyme and lovage.
instructions: Soak the beans overnight, drain and boil them in fresh water for 10 minutes, then drain again.
Simmer the beans with the smoked knuckle in 3 litres of water for about 1 hour until the beans are nearly tender.
Add the diced onion, carrots and bell pepper and cook for 20 minutes more.
Pull the meat off the bone, chop it and return it to the pot with the tomato paste and thyme.
Pour in the borș, boil for 10 minutes, season with salt and finish with chopped lovage.

recipes.name: Romanian Vegetable Sour Soup (Ciorbă de Legume)
recipes.description: Light, garden-fresh ciorbă packed with seasonal vegetables and soured with borș and lovage.
instructions: Dice the onion, carrots, celery root, bell pepper and potatoes.
Sweat the onion and carrots in oil for 5 minutes, then add 2.5 litres of water and the remaining root vegetables.
Simmer for 15 minutes, then add the potatoes, green beans and zucchini and cook for another 15 minutes.
Stir in the grated tomatoes and the borș and boil for 10 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper and finish with plenty of chopped lovage.

recipes.name: Greek-Style Chicken Sour Soup (Ciorbă à la Grec)
recipes.description: Silky chicken and rice soup finished with a sour cream, egg and lemon liaison the Romanian way.
instructions: Simmer the chicken thighs with the carrots, onion and parsley root in 2.5 litres of salted water for 35 minutes.
Remove the chicken, shred the meat and return it to the pot.
Add the rice and cook for 15 minutes until tender.
Whisk the sour cream with the egg yolks and lemon juice, temper with hot soup and stir in off the heat.
Season with salt and white pepper and sprinkle with chopped parsley before serving.

recipes.name: Sorrel Sour Soup (Ciorbă de Ștevie)
recipes.description: Springtime ciorbă of tangy sorrel leaves, rice and green onions, enriched with egg and sour cream.
instructions: Wash the sorrel thoroughly and chop it roughly along with the green onions.
Sweat the chopped green onions and diced carrots in oil for 4 minutes, then add 2 litres of water.
Add the rice and simmer for 15 minutes.
Stir in the sorrel and the borș and boil for 5 minutes.
Beat the eggs with the sour cream, temper with hot soup and stir in off the heat.
Season with salt and finish with chopped dill.

recipes.name: Chicken Soup with Semolina Dumplings
recipes.description: Clear golden chicken broth with fluffy semolina dumplings, the classic Romanian supă cu găluște.
instructions: Cover the chicken pieces with 3 litres of cold water, bring to a boil and skim off the foam.
Add the whole carrots, parsnip, celery root and onion and simmer gently for 1 hour.
Strain the broth, dice the carrots and shred some of the chicken back into it.
Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt, fold in the semolina and let the batter rest for 10 minutes.
Drop teaspoons of batter into the barely simmering broth, cover and cook for 15 minutes without lifting the lid.
Season with salt and serve sprinkled with parsley.

recipes.name: Potato Sour Soup with Smoked Bacon
recipes.description: Rustic Transylvanian ciorbă de cartofi with smoky bacon, sweet peppers and a sharp borș finish.
instructions: Dice the smoked bacon and render it in a large pot until golden.
Add the chopped onion, carrots and bell pepper and cook for 5 minutes.
Pour in 2.5 litres of water, add the cubed potatoes and thyme and simmer for 20 minutes.
Add the grated tomatoes and the borș and boil for 10 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper and stir in the chopped lovage before serving.

recipes.name: Danube Fish Sour Soup (Ciorbă de Pește)
recipes.description: Fisherman's carp ciorbă with tomatoes, peppers and borș, served with garlic sauce and hot chili.
instructions: Clean the carp and cut it into thick steaks; season with salt and set aside.
Simmer the diced onion, carrots, bell pepper and tomatoes in 2.5 litres of water for 20 minutes.
Add the borș and bring back to a rolling boil.
Slide in the fish pieces and simmer gently for 12 minutes without stirring.
Season with salt and lovage, and serve with crushed garlic mixed with a little broth and sliced chili on the side.

recipes.name: Lettuce Soup with Smoked Bacon (Ciorbă de Salată)
recipes.description: Transylvanian lettuce soup with crisp bacon, a garlicky sour cream base and ribbons of egg.
instructions: Fry the diced smoked bacon until crisp, add the chopped onion and soften for 3 minutes.
Stir in the flour, cook for 1 minute, then whisk in 1.5 litres of water and bring to a simmer.
Tear the lettuce into large pieces and add it to the pot with the crushed garlic; simmer for 5 minutes.
Beat the eggs with the sour cream, temper with hot soup and stir in off the heat.
Add the vinegar, season with salt and pepper and serve warm with chopped dill.

recipes.name: Zucchini Sour Soup with Sour Cream
recipes.description: Summery ciorbă de dovlecei with tender zucchini, rice, fresh dill and a swirl of sour cream.
instructions: Sweat the diced onion and carrots in oil for 5 minutes.
Add 2 litres of water and the rice and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the cubed zucchini and grated tomatoes and cook for 10 minutes until just tender.
Pour in the borș and boil for 5 minutes.
Stir the sour cream into a ladle of hot soup, return it to the pot and season with salt.
Finish with chopped dill and serve.

recipes.name: Pumpkin Cream Soup with Croutons
recipes.description: Velvety roasted pumpkin soup with a hint of nutmeg, topped with crunchy croutons and toasted seeds.
instructions: Roast the pumpkin cubes with a drizzle of oil at 200°C for 25 minutes until caramelised.
Soften the chopped onion and carrot in butter in a large pot for 5 minutes.
Add the roasted pumpkin, diced potato and vegetable broth and simmer for 15 minutes.
Blend until smooth, stir in the cream and nutmeg and season with salt and pepper.
Serve topped with croutons and toasted pumpkin seeds.

recipes.name: Kohlrabi Soup with Dill (Supă de Gulii)
recipes.description: Gentle, creamy kohlrabi and potato soup brightened with fresh dill, a Transylvanian favourite.
instructions: Peel and dice the kohlrabi, potatoes and carrot; chop the onion.
Melt the butter, soften the onion for 3 minutes, then add the vegetables and cook for 5 minutes.
Sprinkle over the flour, stir for 1 minute and gradually add the vegetable broth.
Simmer for 20 minutes until the kohlrabi is tender.
Stir in the sour cream, season with salt and pepper and finish with plenty of chopped dill.

recipes.name: Peasant Pork Sour Soup (Ciorbă Țărănească de Porc)
recipes.description: Chunky pork ciorbă loaded with potatoes, green beans, peppers and tomatoes, soured with borș.
instructions: Brown the pork cubes in oil in a large pot, then add 3 litres of water and simmer for 40 minutes, skimming the foam.
Add the diced onion, carrots, celery root and bell pepper and cook for 15 minutes.
Add the cubed potatoes and green beans and simmer for 15 minutes more.
Stir in the grated tomatoes and the borș and boil for 10 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper and finish with chopped lovage; serve with sour cream.

recipes.name: Nettle Soup with Garlic (Supă de Urzici)
recipes.description: Vibrant green spring soup of young nettles, rice and garlic, lifted with lemon and a spoon of sour cream.
instructions: Wearing gloves, wash the nettles and blanch them in boiling water for 2 minutes; drain and chop.
Soften the chopped onion and green onions in oil for 4 minutes.
Add the rice and vegetable broth and simmer for 12 minutes.
Stir in the nettles and crushed garlic and cook for 5 minutes.
Season with salt, pepper and lemon juice and serve with a spoon of sour cream.

recipes.name: Lamb Sour Soup with Tarragon (Ciorbă de Miel)
recipes.description: Easter-style lamb ciorbă with spring onions, tarragon and a sour cream and egg finish.
instructions: Cover the lamb with 3 litres of cold water, bring to a boil and skim, then simmer for 50 minutes.
Add the diced carrots, parsley root and chopped green onions and cook for 15 minutes.
Add the rice and simmer for 15 minutes until tender.
Pour in the borș and boil for 5 minutes.
Whisk the egg yolks with the sour cream, temper with hot soup and stir in off the heat.
Season with salt and finish with chopped tarragon and lovage.

recipes.name: Solyanka
recipes.description: Bold Russian sweet-and-sour soup with smoked sausage, ham, pickles, olives and a lemon-sour cream topping.
instructions: Fry the sliced onion in oil for 5 minutes, add the tomato paste and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the diced smoked sausage and ham and brown lightly.
Pour in the beef broth, add the diced pickles and bay leaf and simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in the sliced olives and capers and cook for 5 minutes.
Season with pepper and a little pickle brine, then serve with a lemon slice and a spoon of sour cream.

recipes.name: Hungarian Goulash Soup (Gulyásleves)
recipes.description: Deep paprika-red beef soup with potatoes, peppers and caraway, somewhere between a stew and a broth.
instructions: Brown the beef cubes in oil in a heavy pot, then remove and set aside.
Soften the chopped onions in the same pot for 8 minutes, take off the heat and stir in the paprika and caraway.
Return the beef, add the garlic, tomatoes and beef broth and simmer covered for 1 hour.
Add the cubed potatoes, carrots and bell pepper and cook for 25 minutes until tender.
Season with salt and pepper and serve with crusty bread.

recipes.name: Minestrone
recipes.description: Classic Italian vegetable soup with beans, pasta and tomatoes, finished with basil and Parmesan.
instructions: Soften the diced onion, carrots and celery in olive oil for 8 minutes.
Add the garlic and zucchini and cook for 2 minutes.
Pour in the crushed tomatoes and vegetable broth and simmer for 15 minutes.
Add the drained beans and the pasta and cook until the pasta is al dente.
Season with salt and pepper, stir in torn basil and serve with grated Parmesan.

recipes.name: French Onion Soup
recipes.description: Deeply caramelised onions in rich beef broth, topped with toasted baguette and bubbling melted cheese.
instructions: Slice the onions thinly and cook them slowly in butter for 40 minutes, stirring often, until deep golden.
Sprinkle over the flour, cook for 1 minute, then deglaze with the white wine.
Add the beef broth, thyme and bay leaf and simmer for 20 minutes; season with salt and pepper.
Toast the baguette slices and ladle the soup into ovenproof bowls.
Top each bowl with toast and grated cheese and grill until golden and bubbling.

recipes.name: Green Lentil and Smoked Sausage Soup
recipes.description: Hearty, smoky lentil soup with kielbasa, root vegetables and a splash of red wine vinegar.
instructions: Brown the sliced smoked sausage in olive oil, then remove and set aside.
Soften the diced onion, carrots and celery in the same pot for 8 minutes; add the garlic.
Add the rinsed lentils, crushed tomatoes, bay leaf and vegetable broth and simmer for 30 minutes.
Return the sausage and cook for 10 minutes until the lentils are tender.
Season with salt, pepper and red wine vinegar and serve.

recipes.name: Spanish Chickpea and Spinach Soup
recipes.description: Smoky paprika-spiced chickpea soup with wilted spinach, tomatoes and a squeeze of lemon.
instructions: Soften the chopped onion in olive oil for 6 minutes, then add the garlic, cumin and smoked paprika.
Add the crushed tomatoes and cook for 3 minutes.
Pour in the vegetable broth and the drained chickpeas and simmer for 15 minutes.
Stir in the spinach and let it wilt for 2 minutes.
Season with salt, pepper and lemon juice and serve drizzled with olive oil.

recipes.name: Potato Leek Soup
recipes.description: Smooth, buttery French-style soup of leeks and potatoes finished with cream and chives.
instructions: Slice the leeks thinly and rinse well; peel and dice the potatoes.
Melt the butter and sweat the leeks gently for 10 minutes without colouring.
Add the potatoes and vegetable broth and simmer for 20 minutes until soft.
Blend until smooth, stir in the cream and season with salt and white pepper.
Serve sprinkled with chopped chives.

recipes.name: Thai Butternut Squash and Coconut Soup
recipes.description: Silky butternut squash soup with red curry paste, coconut milk, ginger and lime.
instructions: Peel and cube the butternut squash; chop the onion, garlic and ginger.
Soften the onion in oil for 5 minutes, add the garlic, ginger and curry paste and fry for 1 minute.
Add the squash and vegetable broth and simmer for 20 minutes until tender.
Blend until smooth, stir in the coconut milk and warm through.
Season with salt and lime juice and serve topped with fresh coriander.

recipes.name: Broccoli Cheddar Soup
recipes.description: Thick, cheesy American-style soup with tender broccoli florets and shredded carrot.
instructions: Melt the butter and soften the chopped onion for 5 minutes.
Stir in the flour and cook for 1 minute, then gradually whisk in the milk and vegetable broth.
Add the broccoli florets and grated carrot and simmer for 15 minutes until tender.
Blend half the soup for a creamier texture, if desired, and return it to the pot.
Remove from the heat, stir in the grated cheddar until melted and season with salt, pepper and nutmeg.

recipes.name: Spanish Garlic Soup (Sopa de Ajo)
recipes.description: Castilian peasant soup of golden garlic, smoked paprika and day-old bread with a poached egg in each bowl.
instructions: Fry the sliced garlic gently in olive oil until golden, then add the diced ham.
Take off the heat, stir in the smoked paprika, then add the torn bread and toss to coat.
Pour in the chicken broth and simmer for 15 minutes until the bread breaks down.
Season with salt and pepper, then crack the eggs into the soup and poach for 3 minutes.
Serve immediately with chopped parsley.

recipes.name: Vietnamese-Style Beef Pho
recipes.description: Fragrant star anise and ginger beef broth over rice noodles with paper-thin beef, herbs and lime.
instructions: Char the halved onion and ginger in a dry pan until blackened in spots.
Simmer the beef broth with the charred onion, ginger, star anise and cinnamon for 30 minutes, then strain.
Season the broth with fish sauce and a pinch of sugar.
Cook the rice noodles according to the pack and divide between bowls.
Top with very thinly sliced raw beef and pour over the boiling broth to cook it.
Serve with bean sprouts, basil, green onions and lime wedges.

recipes.name: Miso Ramen with Pork Belly
recipes.description: Savoury miso and garlic ramen broth with springy noodles, sliced pork belly and a soft-boiled egg.
instructions: Season the pork belly, roast it at 180°C for 50 minutes until tender, then slice.
Soft-boil the eggs for 7 minutes, cool in iced water and peel.
Fry the chopped garlic and ginger in sesame oil for 1 minute, add the chicken broth and simmer for 10 minutes.
Whisk in the miso paste and soy sauce and keep hot without boiling.
Cook the ramen noodles and the bok choy according to the pack.
Divide the noodles between bowls, pour over the broth and top with pork, halved eggs, bok choy, corn and green onions.

recipes.name: Tom Yum-Style Shrimp Soup
recipes.description: Hot and sour Thai broth with juicy shrimp, mushrooms, chili, lime and fresh coriander.
instructions: Bring the chicken broth to a simmer with the sliced ginger, bruised chili and curry paste.
Add the halved mushrooms and cherry tomatoes and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the shrimp and simmer for 3 minutes until pink.
Season with fish sauce, lime juice and a pinch of sugar, tasting for a hot-sour balance.
Serve topped with fresh coriander and sliced green onions.

ingredients.name: Tom yum or red curry paste

recipes.name: Miso Soup with Tofu and Mushrooms
recipes.description: Light Japanese miso broth with silky tofu cubes, mushrooms, spinach and spring onions, ready in minutes.
instructions: Bring the vegetable broth to a gentle simmer with the sliced mushrooms and ginger.
Cook for 5 minutes, then add the spinach and cubed tofu and warm for 2 minutes.
Take off the heat and whisk the miso paste with a ladle of broth until smooth, then stir it back in.
Season with soy sauce and a few drops of sesame oil.
Serve immediately topped with sliced green onions.

recipes.name: Split Pea and Ham Soup
recipes.description: Thick, smoky yellow split pea soup slow-cooked with a ham hock, carrots and bay.
instructions: Rinse the split peas and place them in a large pot with the ham hock and 2.5 litres of water.
Bring to a boil, skim, then add the diced onion, carrots, celery, garlic, bay leaf and thyme.
Simmer for about 90 minutes, stirring now and then, until the peas have broken down.
Remove the hock, shred the meat and stir it back into the soup.
Season with salt and pepper and loosen with a little water if too thick.

recipes.name: Mushroom Barley Soup
recipes.description: Earthy brown mushroom and pearl barley soup with thyme and a savoury splash of soy sauce.
instructions: Brown the sliced mushrooms in olive oil in batches until golden, then set aside.
Soften the diced onion, carrots and celery in the same pot for 8 minutes; add the garlic and thyme.
Add the rinsed barley and vegetable broth and simmer for 35 minutes.
Return the mushrooms, add the soy sauce and cook for 10 minutes until the barley is tender.
Season with salt and pepper and serve sprinkled with parsley.

recipes.name: Tuscan White Bean and Kale Soup
recipes.description: Rustic Italian soup of cannellini beans, kale and rosemary in a tomato-tinged broth with Parmesan.
instructions: Soften the diced onion, carrots and celery in olive oil for 8 minutes.
Add the garlic and rosemary and cook for 1 minute.
Pour in the crushed tomatoes and vegetable broth, add the drained beans and simmer for 15 minutes.
Mash a few beans against the side of the pot to thicken, then stir in the chopped kale and cook for 5 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper and serve with grated Parmesan and a drizzle of olive oil.

recipes.name: Corn Chowder with Bacon
recipes.description: Creamy American sweetcorn and potato chowder with crispy bacon bits and chives.
instructions: Fry the diced bacon until crisp, remove and set aside, leaving the fat in the pot.
Add the butter, chopped onion and celery and soften for 5 minutes.
Stir in the flour, then gradually add the chicken broth and the diced potatoes; simmer for 15 minutes.
Add the drained corn and the milk and simmer for 5 minutes more.
Stir in the cream, season with salt and pepper and serve topped with bacon and chives.

recipes.name: Creamy Cod and Potato Chowder
recipes.description: New England-style fish chowder with flaky cod, potatoes, leek and bacon in a creamy milk broth.
instructions: Fry the diced bacon until golden, then add the butter, sliced leek and chopped onion and soften for 6 minutes.
Sprinkle over the flour, stir, then add the diced potatoes, bay leaf and 500 ml of water; simmer for 15 minutes.
Pour in the milk and bring to a gentle simmer.
Add the cod in large chunks and poach for 5 minutes until just flaking.
Stir in the cream, season with salt and pepper and serve with chopped parsley.

recipes.name: Carrot and Ginger Soup
recipes.description: Bright, sweet carrot soup with warming ginger, a touch of orange and a swirl of coconut milk.
instructions: Soften the chopped onion in olive oil for 5 minutes, then add the garlic, grated ginger and cumin.
Add the sliced carrots and vegetable broth and simmer for 25 minutes until very soft.
Blend until completely smooth.
Stir in the coconut milk and the juice of the orange and warm through.
Season with salt and pepper and serve with a drizzle of coconut milk.

recipes.name: Cauliflower Cream Soup with Parmesan
recipes.description: Luxuriously smooth cauliflower soup with garlic, nutmeg and Parmesan, low in carbs and big on comfort.
instructions: Cut the cauliflower into florets and chop the onion and garlic.
Melt the butter and sweat the onion and garlic for 5 minutes without browning.
Add the cauliflower, potato and vegetable broth and simmer for 20 minutes until tender.
Blend until silky, then stir in the cream and grated Parmesan.
Season with salt, white pepper and nutmeg and serve.

recipes.name: Zucchini and Basil Cream Soup
recipes.description: Light green zucchini soup blended with cream cheese and fresh basil for a summery, velvety bowl.
instructions: Soften the chopped onion and garlic in olive oil for 5 minutes.
Add the sliced zucchini and diced potato, pour in the vegetable broth and simmer for 15 minutes.
Add the basil leaves and blend until smooth.
Whisk in the cream cheese until melted and season with salt and pepper.
Serve warm or chilled with a drizzle of olive oil.

recipes.name: Portuguese Caldo Verde
recipes.description: Portugal's beloved potato and kale soup with slices of smoky chorizo and good olive oil.
instructions: Soften the chopped onion and garlic in olive oil for 5 minutes.
Add the diced potatoes and vegetable broth and simmer for 20 minutes until soft.
Blend the soup until smooth and return it to the pot.
Fry the sliced chorizo in a pan until crisp at the edges.
Stir the finely shredded kale into the soup and cook for 5 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper and serve topped with chorizo and a drizzle of olive oil.

recipes.name: Moroccan Harira
recipes.description: Warmly spiced Moroccan soup of lamb, chickpeas, lentils and tomatoes with fresh coriander and lemon.
instructions: Brown the diced lamb in olive oil, then add the chopped onion and celery and soften for 5 minutes.
Stir in the turmeric, cinnamon, ginger powder and pepper and cook for 1 minute.
Add the crushed tomatoes, lentils and 2 litres of water and simmer for 45 minutes.
Add the drained chickpeas and half the chopped herbs and cook for 15 minutes.
Whisk the flour with a little cold water, stir it in and simmer for 5 minutes to thicken.
Season with salt and lemon juice and serve with the remaining coriander and parsley.

recipes.name: Coconut Red Lentil Dal Soup
recipes.description: Creamy Indian-spiced red lentil soup with coconut milk, turmeric and garam masala.
instructions: Fry the chopped onion in oil for 6 minutes, then add the garlic, grated ginger, turmeric and cumin.
Add the rinsed red lentils, crushed tomatoes and vegetable broth and simmer for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in the coconut milk and garam masala and cook for 5 minutes more.
Season with salt and lime juice.
Serve topped with fresh coriander and a little chili if you like heat.

recipes.name: Ukrainian Borscht
recipes.description: Ruby-red beetroot and beef soup with cabbage, potatoes and garlic, served with sour cream and dill.
instructions: Simmer the beef in 2.5 litres of water with a bay leaf for 1 hour, skimming, then dice the meat and return it to the broth.
Grate the beetroot and carrots and fry them with the chopped onion in oil for 8 minutes; stir in the tomato paste and vinegar.
Add the diced potatoes to the broth and cook for 10 minutes.
Add the shredded cabbage and the beetroot mixture and simmer for 15 minutes.
Stir in the crushed garlic, season with salt and pepper and rest for 10 minutes.
Serve with sour cream and chopped dill.

recipes.name: Mexican Chicken Tortilla Soup
recipes.description: Smoky tomato and chili chicken soup topped with crunchy tortilla strips, avocado and lime.
instructions: Soften the chopped onion in oil for 5 minutes, add the garlic, chopped chili and cumin and fry for 1 minute.
Add the crushed tomatoes and chicken broth and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the chicken breast and poach for 15 minutes, then shred it and return to the pot with the drained corn and beans.
Cut the tortillas into strips and fry them in oil until crisp.
Season the soup with salt and lime juice and serve topped with tortilla strips, diced avocado and coriander.

recipes.name: Italian Wedding Soup
recipes.description: Little Parmesan meatballs, orzo and spinach in a light chicken broth, an Italian-American classic.
instructions: Mix the minced turkey with the breadcrumbs, grated Parmesan, egg, half the garlic, salt and pepper and roll into small meatballs.
Soften the chopped onion and diced carrots in olive oil for 6 minutes; add the remaining garlic.
Pour in the chicken broth, bring to a simmer and drop in the meatballs; cook for 10 minutes.
Add the orzo and cook for 8 minutes until tender.
Stir in the spinach until wilted, season with salt and pepper and serve with extra Parmesan.
